writtenAt: 2026-10-11 (before evaluation; the API side probed that day, the web shop and the admin area not looked at, so the pages may hold defects this key doesn't list)
format: a loose product-owner story, no numbered criteria, web shop and API together; the checks need a chain of data: a customer, their question, an administrator's answer, the status after it, then what the owner, another customer and a visitor may see

defects.description: questions are not private: another customer can read a question by its id (200) and answer it (201); only the list of their own messages leaves it out
the customer who asked can change the status of their question (PUT /messages/{id}/status answers 200)
the API accepts a message shorter than 50 characters (49 characters: 200)

traps: a question can't be deleted: every run leaves its questions on the shared demo
a new question answers 200, not 201: the story states no status, so that is not a finding
an administrator's answer moves the question to IN_PROGRESS as required; so does the customer's own reply after RESOLVED, which no criterion covers
the status list is NEW, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED: any other value is refused with 422
